summary: Host-local retirement-qualified learner samples conservative resource profiles and brakes pressured admission. Samples persist per execution generation and the estimator reads a bounded trailing window.

replay.detail: One immutable sample row per qualified execution generation is retained, including outside the estimator's trailing window, so replays stay deduplicated.

schema.detail: Local resource_profile_samples_v1 stores host-local sample rows. Local resource_admission_pending_v1 deduplicates withheld membership evidence for bounded maintenance replay; its CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS migration is additive and idempotent, and an older binary can reopen the store while ignoring the extra table. RequestClass gains recovery in wire commands and persisted execution/membership state. General admission registry compatibility comes from E0; client-v0 schema inputs and generated outputs are unchanged.

rules.detail: Samples are recorded only in the terminal receipt transaction after confirmed whole-tree retirement; rejected or truncated retirements are not admitted. Recovery admission requires signed resource_recovery_observations=1 advertisements from every active fleet incarnation, the host profile's recoveryCapable gate, and a measured filesystem free-space observation. Authority initialization and live observation writes use the same fleet gate. Withheld live evidence atomically enqueues a deduplicated membership ID and marks durable coverage incomplete; SLO certification requires both a complete cut and a live authority. Advertisement restoration alone cannot certify stale facts. A dedicated five-second maintenance deadline is consumed by the daemon scheduler while facts or their incomplete cut remain pending, even without new traffic. Each writer transaction attempts at most 32 queued IDs and validates the fleet-reader barrier at most once for that page. Successful IDs are removed; blocked IDs rotate behind existing work, so continuous withheld traffic cannot reset progress or starve older work. Only an empty pending queue restores completeness.

compatibility.detail: Recovery is a new wire and persisted RequestClass value. Pre-reader E0 versions reject recovery during Json<Command> extraction, and one persisted recovery execution can fail their whole selected execution-list read. The minimum rollback-reader revision is E0 #6762 at 5d1ca588115d972d2838a7ea673bb04d0cec442b. e8836f59 is the lossless decoding milestone; 979e9996 adds withdrawal preservation, 1a048f9e adds shell/program-child cancellation fences, b902952c prevents authority initialization from failing on unknown observations, and the final E0 adds unsupported queued/DSL isolation plus fleet-safe publication deferral. Tests cover targeted preservation/refusal guarantees, not every E1 field or a live end-to-end rollback. Main-only and older E0 registries through b902952c reject replicated recovery or recovery-not-allowed enum values as invalid-replicated-claim: those records are quarantined and their envelope degraded, but later known claims still replicate and project. They are not retryable unknown fields. Final E0 accepts arbitrary evidence class strings and the recovery refusal code without granting those classes admission authority. E1 still gates recovery admission and observation writes on signed resource_recovery_observations support from every active reader, not existing health versions or recoveryCapable alone.

downtime.detail: No host deployment or caller cutover is activated by this change.

manual.detail: Deploy at least E0 5d1ca588115d972d2838a7ea673bb04d0cec442b to hosts and clients that may read recovery state before enabling E1 writers. Upgrade every active fleet reader to E1 and obtain its signed resource_recovery_observations=1 daemon advertisement before publishing recovery admissions; the barrier refuses missing, unsigned, or false evidence. Upgrade execution hosts before routing recovery commands there and keep recoveryCapable disabled until then. Older hosts must continue receiving only previously supported classes.

recovery.detail: Retained sample rows provide permanent replay dedupe. Do not roll recovery state back to pre-reader E0 versions; the minimum rollback reader is 5d1ca588115d972d2838a7ea673bb04d0cec442b. Its tested guarantees concern class strings, mixed-row readability, refusal fences, targeted cancellation and membership custody, not complete E1 metadata preservation or continued recovery semantics. Unsupported-class restart and background cleanup paths report and defer reconciliation; authority initialization withholds their observations and publishes incomplete coverage instead of failing supported work. A downgraded fleet advertisement also defers E1 recovery observations into the additive pending-ID queue. The bounded authority maintenance tick repairs that queue without new traffic before restoring completeness. Older binaries ignore its extra table rather than dropping pending state; E1 authority acquisition rebuilds missing work from retained custody. This is not a live rollback certification. Preserve original state and upgrade forward to E1 for supported reconciliation, including invalid enum observations quarantined by an older receiver. Reclamation of samples outside the trailing window remains separate retention debt.
